## Overview

Gives each animated child a delay from its DOM order, from the first, last or centre child, so
lists cascade without index bookkeeping.

Stable API — covered by semantic-versioning guarantees.

- **Kind:** Directive
- **Stability:** `stable`

## Selector

```text
[moveStagger]
```

## Inputs

| Input | Type | Default | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `moveStagger` | `unknown` | `100` |  | Delay between consecutive children — a `MoveTime`: a number is milliseconds, or `"80ms"` / `"0.08s"`. A bare `moveStagger` attribute uses the 100ms default. Transform `(inline function)`; reads as `number \| "" \| MoveSpring`. |
| `moveStaggerStep` | `unknown` | `undefined` |  | Overrides `moveStagger`'s step — same `MoveTime` units. Transform `optionalTimeAttribute('moveStaggerStep')`; reads as `number \| undefined`. |
| `moveStaggerDirection` | [`MoveStaggerDirection`](/docs/reference/move-stagger-direction) | `'first'` |  |  |
